# Popol Vuh — QUESTIONS

- 2026-11-24 · popol-vuh-004 (draft; nothing blocked): (1) the grindstone word (003 `caa`, 004 `ꜫaa`) is given mt kaa in both parts; the full modern form may be ka', and if so both parts should change together. - 2026-11-24 · popol-vuh-005 (draft; nothing blocked): (1) `Zaqui Nima Ꜩiz`: the image has the plain tz ligature (no comma), but mt gives Tz'iis, the name known from 001/003 (ꜯyꜩ), on the 004 precedent of following the known word over the letter (ꜫaa → kaa). (3) Hunhunahpu occurs 6 times where the actor elsewhere is Hunahpu; printed as written, the note says so. (4) For the establisher: the establishment log says Brasseur prints acalab with k; the OCR has plain c. At high zoom `chirihtac` on i0023 may carry a ti/it ligature (Brasseur rihitak); the text is pinned and was not changed. (5) `vꜭhapa` is given mt uch'apa by the letter rule, though the modern verb is chap with plain ch; the note says so.
